header.formula: 2**n mm for a known valid exponent; zero overridden as unknown
header.scope: satellite over the entire file; intended one standard deviation

EP.coordinate_sigma_representation: direct integer mm, not exponent; introductory range 1..9999; 9999 too large

g08_literal_copy_control.conclusion: G30 alone cannot justify a literal verbatim header-exponent copy for this entire column; no data corruption proven

outcomes.question: Correct format, G30 slot and daily-table alignment?
outcomes.established_interpretation: SP3-c; zero-based 29 / ordinal30; list line4 and accuracy line9 slot13; Jan1 table3.2295.1 MJD60310.
outcomes.unresolved_or_limitation: Scope is retained file metadata; GP identity qualification remains absent.

outcomes.question: Meaning of raw G30 header 2?
outcomes.established_interpretation: Base-2 exponent; code decoding 4 mm; zero would mean unknown; entire-satellite-file standard-deviation intention.
outcomes.unresolved_or_limitation: Not an empirical calibration, maximum error or per-axis sigma.

outcomes.question: What exactly do G30 weekly-summary values mean?
outcomes.established_interpretation: Table1.b day1 raw3 labelled combined position sigma mm; Table3 firstIGS raw2 caption-linked to header accuracy measure.
source_references: weekly_summary:Table1.2295.b line498 and Table3 caption lines633-646 / line723
outcomes.unresolved_or_limitation: Table3 encoding, exact computed statistic and link to Table1/header require producer clarification.

outcomes.question: What is G30 seven-day orbit-dynamics value?
outcomes.established_interpretation: Table3 lastIGS raw25 mm is fit RMS of IGS orbit through seven-day evaluation, separate from weighted-average/accuracy indicators.
outcomes.unresolved_or_limitation: Definition/recorded value resolved; exact generator run and absolute calibration not established.

outcomes.question: Are global RMS/WRMS the same scope as G30, and what are IGS values?
outcomes.established_interpretation: Different aggregate scope. Left global RMS/WRMS have blank IGS fields; right labels T/NE have IGS33/29 mm. NE is non-eclipsing RMS, not WRMS.
outcomes.unresolved_or_limitation: Exact population, weights and algorithm not reconstructed. Source says X excluded from statistics, T all satellites; do not infer equal weights.

outcomes.question: Do P/EP definitions and actual availability agree?
outcomes.established_interpretation: P coordinate base1.25 and field slots correct; zero1mm, blankunknown,99censored. No EP; absent correlations unknown.
outcomes.unresolved_or_limitation: Format definitions are not a calibrated covariance; no cross-time/provider independence or confidence intervals inferred.

outcomes.question: Does available IGS inspector interpret this supported profile correctly?
outcomes.established_interpretation: Matching slot flattening, raw header exponents and base/axis fields agree; 25 selected existing synthetic parser tests pass.
outcomes.unresolved_or_limitation: Narrow80-columnP profile; no EP/SUM decoding; raw99count retained but short rule does not enumerate censoring. No actual G30 misinterpretation shown; no code changed.

outcomes.question: Is exact 3/2/4 relationship resolved?
outcomes.established_interpretation: Definitions distinguish header/P/fit/global scopes; they do not uniquely identify Table3 encoding or Table1/header generator relationship.
outcomes.unresolved_or_limitation: Need versioned statistic/encoding/rounding definitions and immutable SP3/SUM run/revision linkage. G08 counterexample forbids assuming literal exponent copy; no corruption established.

outcomes.question: Can G30 indicators be used quantitatively without further information?
outcomes.established_interpretation: Raw transcription and valid field-code decoding only. No scientific bounds, covariance, confidence, independent-accuracy or comparison error estimate supported.
outcomes.unresolved_or_limitation: Resolve actual GP and essential frame/EOP/point/quality/provenance/claims/protocol gates plus explicit authorization; missing covariances remain unknown.

allowed_quantitative_operations: transcribe original reported values with scope and source
decode known valid format codes without treating them as physical error bounds
prohibited_inferences: Treat Table3 firstIGS integer as exponent without a producer definition
Equate global RMS/WRMS/T/NE to G30-only indicator
Call right-side NE a WRMS statistic
Fill blank global IGS weighted-side values with zero
Use guessed sqrt(3), rounding or smallest-value selection to force agreement
